Sensitivity of RepeatMasker recovery rate to the reciprocal-overlap threshold

05 November, 2026

Revision item 26 (R3-minor#10). The Fig. 5 recovery rate counts a simulated TE as recovered when a RepeatMasker hit overlaps it reciprocally by >= 80%. The same RepeatMasker output (four Fig. 3D scenarios, replicates 1-5) is re-evaluated at 50%, 70%, 80% and 90% reciprocal overlap (16_tair10_overlap_threshold_sweep.sh). Base-pair-level recall and precision, which need no threshold, are reported in 25.1_item23_28_benchmark_repeatmasker.Rmd.

4. Notes

  • The evaluation is strand- and family-agnostic, as in Fig. 5: any RepeatMasker hit with the required reciprocal overlap counts. Family and superfamily accuracy are in 25.1_item23_28_benchmark_repeatmasker.Rmd (scenario 1).
  • Lower thresholds accept hits that cover only part of a fragmented copy, or hits that extend well beyond it; higher thresholds require nearly exact boundaries.
